title: 3EN002 comprehensive security audit
description: Large read-only security audit of OpenWrt 3EN002 via the dedicated SSH key. Collects listening sockets, service/process inventory, Dropbear/SSH and uHTTPd/LuCI configuration, firewall/nftables exposure, banIP state, cron/init services, installed packages, accounts, mounts, kernel/security-relevant sysctls, recent security logs, and basic WAN exposure indicators. No configuration changes are made.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $HostIp='192.168.1.2'; $User='root'; $Key=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ssh\3en002_agent_ed25519'; $ssh=(Get-Command ssh.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $Key)){throw ('SSH key missing: '+$Key)}; Write-Host '=== 3EN002 COMPREHENSIVE SECURITY AUDIT 012 ==='; Write-Host ('Time='+(Get-Date -Format o)); Write-Host ('Target='+$User+'@'+$HostIp); $remote='echo === SYSTEM ===; ubus call system board 2>/dev/null || true; uname -a; uptime; echo; echo === LISTENING_SOCKETS ===; (ss -lntup 2>/dev/null || netstat -lntup 2>/dev/null || true); echo; echo === PROCESSES ===; ps w 2>/dev/null || ps 2>/dev/null; echo; echo === DROPBEAR_CONFIG ===; uci show dropbear 2>&1 || true; cat /etc/config/dropbear 2>/dev/null || true; echo; echo === AUTHORIZED_KEYS_META ===; ls -la /etc/dropbear 2>/dev/null || true; wc -l /etc/dropbear/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null || true; echo; echo === UHTTPD_CONFIG ===; uci show uhttpd 2>&1 || true; cat /etc/config/uhttpd 2>/dev/null || true; echo; echo === RPCD_CONFIG ===; uci show rpcd 2>&1 || true; cat /etc/config/rpcd 2>/dev/null || true; echo; echo === FIREWALL_UCI ===; uci show firewall 2>&1; echo; echo === NFT_RULESET ===; nft list ruleset 2>&1; echo; echo === BANIP ===; if command -v banip-status >/dev/null 2>&1; then banip-status 2>&1; elif [ -x /etc/init.d/banip ]; then /etc/init.d/banip status 2>&1; fi; echo; echo === INIT_SERVICES ===; for f in /etc/init.d/*; do [ -x
enabled >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo ENABLED: ))}'' /etc/shadow 2>/dev/null || true; echo; echo === PACKAGES_SECURITY_RELEVANT ===; opkg list-installed 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei ''dropbear|uhttpd|luci|rpcd|firewall|nft|banip|dnsmasq|odhcpd|openssl|wolfssl|mbedtls|wireguard|openvpn|ipsec|strongswan|tailscale|zerotier|adblock|https-dns-proxy|stubby|unbound'' || true; echo; echo === ALL_PACKAGES ===; opkg list-installed 2>/dev/null || true; echo; echo === MOUNTS ===; mount 2>/dev/null; echo; df -h 2>/dev/null; echo; echo === SYSCTL_SECURITY ===; for k in net.ipv4.ip_forward net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter net.ipv4.conf.default.rp_filter net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects net.ipv4.icmp_echo_ignore_broadcasts net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_redirects kernel.randomize_va_space; do printf

2>/dev/null || echo NA; done; echo; echo === NETWORK ===; uci show network 2>&1; ip addr 2>&1; ip route 2>&1; echo; echo === DNS_DHCP ===; cat /etc/config/dhcp 2>/dev/null; echo; echo === WAN_RELATED_LOGS ===; logread 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei ''dropbear|uhttpd|rpcd|firewall|banip|blocked|reject|wan|auth|login|failed|error|warn'' | tail -n 500; echo; echo === RECENT_LOGREAD ===; logread -l 500 2>/dev/null || logread 2>/dev/null | tail -n 500; echo; echo === AUDIT_END ==='; & $ssh -i $Key -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 -o ConnectionAttempts=1 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o ServerAliveInterval=5 -o ServerAliveCountMax=1 ($User+'@'+$HostIp) $remote 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Host ('SSH_EXIT_CODE='+$rc); if($rc -ne 0){throw ('Security audit SSH failed rc='+$rc)}; Write-Host 'SECURITY_AUDIT=PASS'
